name: Handles, Finishes & Jumpers
summary: Warm up your handle, attack the rim in two dribbles, hit elbow jumpers, then finish with shooting under fatigue.

drills.name: Between-the-Legs Walk-Ups
drills.summary: Get loose and control the ball through your legs on the move.
steps: Start on the baseline in a low stance.
Walk forward and go between the legs on every step.
Keep the ball low and snap it hand to hand.
At half court, turn and walk back the same way.
Last minute: speed up to a jog and stay clean.

drills.name: Two-Dribble Rim Attacks
drills.summary: Get from the arc to the rim in two dribbles or less.
steps: Start at the right wing behind the three-point line.
Jab, then attack the rim with two hard dribbles max.
Finish with a right-hand layup off the glass.
Rebound, go to the left wing, and finish lefty.
Rotate wing, top, and both corners each round.

drills.name: Elbow-to-Elbow Shuffle Shots
drills.summary: Shoot from the elbow, shuffle across, and get set fast.
steps: Start at the right elbow, ball in your shot pocket.
Shoot a jumper, grab the rebound, and spin the ball out to yourself at the left elbow.
Hop into the catch with your feet set and shoot again.
Keep going elbow to elbow for the full time.
Count your makes and try to beat it next time.

drills.name: Make-Two Sprint Rounds
drills.summary: Make two shots, sprint, then shoot again while tired.
steps: Start at the free throw line.
Shoot until you make two in a row.
Leave the ball at the line, sprint to half court and back.
If you are on a driveway, sprint to the end and back.
Repeat for the full time and count your rounds.
